constraints: Passing -1 in menuItem designates the last item added to menu.

If menu is a MenuRef, the command applies to all instances of the menu across all processes and the process parameter is ignored; if menu is a menu number, it applies to the main menu bar of the current process (or of process, if given).
If the menu item is the title of a hierarchical sub-menu, methodName is not called when the item is selected.
